title: Ashgrove Secondaries Fund V, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: Ashgrove Secondaries Fund V is a 2023 vintage secondaries fund with total commitments of $3.1 billion. As of June 30, 2026, called capital was $1.94 billion, representing 62.6% of commitments. The fund acquires LP interests and leads GP-led continuation vehicle transactions.

title: Ashgrove Secondaries Fund V, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: As of June 30, 2026, the fund reported a net IRR of 21.7%. Net TVPI was 1.38x, DPI was 0.29x and RVPI was 1.09x. Net asset value was $2.11 billion. The fund distributed $163 million during the quarter.

title: Ashgrove Secondaries Fund V, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: During the quarter, the fund acquired a $420 million portfolio of 14 buyout fund interests at an average discount of 11% to NAV. The fund also led a $275 million single-asset continuation vehicle for Ostrava Packaging. Underlying exposure spans more than 610 portfolio companies across 58 funds.

title: Ashgrove Secondaries Fund V, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: Average purchase discounts across the fund are 13% to reported NAV. Approximately 71% of underlying NAV is in buyout strategies, 18% in growth equity and 11% in venture. The manager expects deal volume to remain elevated as LPs seek liquidity.

title: Ashgrove Secondaries Fund V, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: The management fee is 1.0% of commitments during the investment period. Carried interest is 12.5% above an 8% preferred return.

title: Corvid Growth Equity Fund IV, LP Letter Q1 2026
text: Corvid Growth Equity Fund IV is a 2022 vintage growth equity fund focused on vertical software and fintech, with total commitments of $780 million. As of March 31, 2026, the fund has called $512 million, or 65.6% of commitments.

title: Corvid Growth Equity Fund IV, LP Letter Q1 2026
text: As of March 31, 2026, the fund's net IRR was 6.2% and gross IRR was 11.9%. Net TVPI was 1.12x, DPI was 0.04x and RVPI was 1.08x. Net asset value stood at $553 million. The fund made its first meaningful distribution of $21 million following a secondary sale of shares in Ledgerline.

title: Corvid Growth Equity Fund IV, LP Letter Q1 2026
text: The fund led a $60 million Series D round in Pathwise Payments and invested $35 million in Tallyform, a construction ERP provider. Two portfolio companies, Brightcove Analytics and Quillon, were marked down by a combined $18 million due to slower revenue growth. The portfolio contains 16 companies.

title: Corvid Growth Equity Fund IV, LP Letter Q1 2026
text: Portfolio companies are valued primarily on forward revenue multiples. The median revenue multiple applied was 6.4x NTM revenue, compared with 7.1x a year earlier. Weighted average revenue growth across the portfolio was 38% year over year. The manager expects to complete deployment by the end of 2027.

title: Corvid Growth Equity Fund IV, LP Letter Q1 2026
text: The management fee is 2.0% of committed capital. Carried interest is 20%, rising to 25% for returns above 3.0x net MOIC.

title: Halden Infrastructure Fund II, Annual Report 2025
text: Halden Infrastructure Fund II is a 2021 vintage European core-plus infrastructure fund with commitments of EUR 2.4 billion. As of December 31, 2025, called capital was EUR 1.71 billion, representing 71.3% of commitments. The fund targets energy transition, digital infrastructure and transport assets.

title: Halden Infrastructure Fund II, Annual Report 2025
text: At December 31, 2025, the fund generated a net IRR of 9.8% since inception. Net TVPI was 1.24x, DPI was 0.18x and RVPI was 1.06x. The fund's net asset value was EUR 1.81 billion. Cash yield distributed to investors during 2025 totaled EUR 96 million, equivalent to a 5.6% distribution yield on invested capital.

title: Halden Infrastructure Fund II, Annual Report 2025
text: In 2025 the fund acquired a 49% stake in Nordlys Fibre, a Norwegian fibre-to-the-home operator, for EUR 310 million. The fund also completed construction of the 420 MW Valdera solar portfolio in Spain, which reached commercial operation in October 2025. The portfolio comprises 9 platform investments.

title: Halden Infrastructure Fund II, Annual Report 2025
text: Approximately 64% of portfolio revenues are contracted or regulated. The fund reported Scope 1 and 2 emissions intensity of 38 tCO2e per EUR million of revenue, a 22% reduction year on year. Interest rate exposure is 78% hedged through 2028.

title: Halden Infrastructure Fund II, Annual Report 2025
text: The management fee is 1.25% of committed capital during the investment period. Carried interest is 15% above a 7% hurdle.

title: Meridian Private Credit Fund I, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: Meridian Private Credit Fund I is a 2020 vintage senior direct lending fund with commitments of $1.6 billion. As of June 30, 2026, the fund had called $1.38 billion, or 86.3% of commitments, and the fund uses a subscription facility with a $200 million limit.

title: Meridian Private Credit Fund I, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: As of June 30, 2026, the fund delivered a net IRR of 10.6%. Net TVPI was 1.31x, DPI was 0.74x and RVPI was 0.57x. Net asset value was $787 million. Distributions during the quarter totaled $58 million, consisting primarily of interest income and loan repayments.

title: Meridian Private Credit Fund I, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: The fund holds 41 loans with a weighted average yield of 11.3% and a weighted average loan-to-value of 42%. Approximately 96% of the portfolio is first lien senior secured debt. Two loans, representing 1.8% of fair value, are on non-accrual status. Cumulative realized losses since inception are 0.4% of invested capital.

title: Meridian Private Credit Fund I, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: Spreads on new originations averaged SOFR plus 525 basis points during the quarter, compared with SOFR plus 575 basis points a year ago. The manager notes increased competition from bank lenders in the upper middle market.

title: Meridian Private Credit Fund I, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: The management fee is 1.0% of invested capital. Incentive fee is 10% above a 6% hurdle.

title: Northvale Capital Partners Fund III, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: Northvale Capital Partners Fund III is a 2019 vintage North American mid-market buyout fund with total commitments of $1.25 billion. As of June 30, 2026, the fund has called $1.02 billion, or 81.6% of commitments. The investment period ended in March 2025 and the fund is now in its harvesting phase.

title: Northvale Capital Partners Fund III, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: As of June 30, 2026, the fund reported a net IRR of 17.4% and a gross IRR of 23.1%. Net TVPI stood at 1.86x, with DPI of 0.92x and RVPI of 0.94x. Net asset value was $958 million. Cumulative distributions to limited partners reached $938 million, of which $214 million was distributed during the quarter.

title: Northvale Capital Partners Fund III, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: During the quarter the fund completed the sale of Ridgeline Logistics to a strategic buyer, generating gross proceeds of $286 million and a gross MOIC of 3.1x. The fund also made a $45 million add-on investment in Carta Health Systems to support its acquisition of a regional billing platform. The portfolio now consists of 11 active companies.

title: Northvale Capital Partners Fund III, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: Portfolio companies are valued using a blend of comparable trading multiples and discounted cash flow analysis. The weighted average EV/EBITDA multiple applied across the portfolio was 11.2x, down from 11.8x at year-end 2025, reflecting lower public market comparables in industrial services. Net leverage across the portfolio averaged 4.3x EBITDA. Management expects two further exits in the next twelve months.

title: Northvale Capital Partners Fund III, Quarterly Report Q2 2026
text: The management fee stepped down from 2.0% of commitments to 1.5% of net invested capital after the investment period. Carried interest is 20% above an 8% preferred return with a full catch-up.
